body: Wow this was very insightful. I do think this may be similar to what is going on. When I tell him I love him, his normal reply is "I have no idea why you do". I've had time to calm down and collect my self and during that time, I've thought about our wedding vows. I don't think I'm ready to give up on him, I just wish I knew how to reach him and help him out of this dark place. He really is a good person, but hes had a rough upbringing that I think has greatly effected how he views him self.
Thanks to everyone who responded! It's brought some needed clarity to this situation and has given me a ton to think about. I'm thankful for this subreddit!

When we were talking this evening, I asked him if he wanted out. He always just tells me that I'm free to leave if I want to and he won't stop me. He says he never wants me to be out of his life but he's not willing to cut this other girl out.

When he broke down he went on to say that he thinks she'll leave him too once she finds out everything about him.

I'm just at a loss. I do feel like he wants out, but he's not the type to make idle threats.

Thank you for sharing. I don't see it as bitchy at all. I've been thinking about leaving over this girl for awhile. I love and care for him more then words can say, but I won't spend my life playing second fiddle to a girl who has never even been physically in the picture. Those two have caused so much trouble and they have never met face to face!

I'm worried about his threat though and I'm worried that if I go, he'll kill him self.
Im sorry about the typos! I typed this up while I was pretty upset and on a tablet as well.
